headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The American League All-Stars dominated the National League All-Stars in the Midsummer Classic, securing a 4-0 victory. Miguel Vargas led the offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Red Sox made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade.

Injuries continue to plague several teams. The Kansas City Royals transferred right-handed pitcher Nick Mears from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement. The Baltimore Orioles also transferred left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Other teams have placed players on the injured list, including the Arizona Diamondbacks, Texas Rangers, Cincinnati Reds, Miami Marlins, Milwaukee Brewers, and Atlanta Braves.

Several teams have made trades and roster moves. The Boston Red Sox acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The Kansas City Royals acquired right-handed pitcher Easton McGee from the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Baltimore Orioles acquired right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros.
